# <box-name> <incus-state> <scenario>   — see test/stub-box
#
# A SMALL fleet for the cli/crew roster-loop tests, deliberately separate from
# fixtures/fleet.txt: that one contains `ff-wedged`, whose exec never answers
# (the collector must time out on it), and cli/crew has no probe timeout — one
# wedged box would hang the suite for two minutes per call.
#
# What is here is what the roster loops must survive: a hired box, a stopped
# one, one never hired, one whose logins are dead, and one that is not on the
# host at all. Every row exercises a different branch of `crew status`.
cli-hired      running  working
cli-idle       running  idle
cli-stopped    stopped  working
cli-nothired   running  nothired
cli-noauth     running  noauth
cli-absent     absent   working
